title: Agent Chess Operations Board
summary: A reader-facing view of how multiple agent roles coordinate work through moves, reviews, gates, and artifacts without exposing instructions or infrastructure.
public_rule: Public view shows role boundaries, board tempo, review gates, and safe artifact types only.
no_private_data_policy: No internal agent instructions are displayed.
No local machine paths, server addresses, account identifiers, keys, tokens, or credentials are displayed.
No employer, client, or personally sensitive records are used.
External action stays behind a human review gate.

lanes.label: Move Lane
lanes.purpose: A worker proposes one bounded next move with a visible outcome and a stated limit.

lanes.label: Review Lane
lanes.purpose: A separate reviewer checks wording, risk, claims, and whether the move exposes too much detail.

lanes.label: Gate Lane
lanes.purpose: Human review is required before publishing, pushing, sending, or changing external state.

lanes.label: Artifact Lane
lanes.purpose: Only reader-facing summaries, snapshots, screenshots, or article links belong on the website.

flow.label: Move
flow.description: One role advances a bounded task.

flow.label: Review
flow.description: Another role checks claims, taste, and safety.

flow.label: Gate
flow.description: External action waits for explicit approval.

flow.label: Artifact
flow.description: A safe public record is published or linked.

roles.label: Builder
roles.boundary: Can draft and implement bounded changes; cannot approve its own public claim.

roles.label: Reviewer
roles.boundary: Can challenge wording, risk, and evidence; cannot bypass the gate.

roles.label: Scout
roles.boundary: Can collect outside context; cannot introduce private records.

roles.label: Renderer
roles.boundary: Can create visual packets from approved public briefs; cannot expose source internals.

boards.label: Capital Signals
boards.last_move: Evidence state is checked before the next public claim.

boards.label: Website Operations
boards.last_move: A context-signal layer is live on the homepage.

boards.label: Content Operations
boards.last_move: One brief can become a carousel packet.

now_playing.public_state: A taste and boundary pass is next.

safety_note: This page shows orchestration patterns only. It does not expose instructions, credentials, account details, infrastructure, or autonomous authority.
